title: Private Tour: Chugach State Park Hiking Tour from Anchorage
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Operates in all weather conditions; please dress appropriately
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Explore Chugach State Park by foot on this private hiking tour led by a naturalist guide. Leave Anchorage and travel through the Chugach foothills to the country's third-largest state park for a day of hiking and wildlife viewing. Soak up unrivaled mountain vistas, spot wildlife such as moose and eagles, and learn about the rich geology, ecology and history of the park from your guide.
